title: Amulet of Restoration
summary: Cast Healing Word and Mass Healing Word as Bonus Actions, once per Long Rest each. Each heals 1d4 plus spellcasting modifier per target.

fields.Effect: Cast Healing Word and Mass Healing Word as Bonus Actions, once per Long Rest each. Each heals 1d4 plus spellcasting modifier per target.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Healing Word: Bonus Action once per Long Rest. Heal one visible ally within 60 ft for 1d4 plus the caster’s spellcasting ability modifier.
fields.Mass Healing Word: Bonus Action once per Long Rest. Heal eligible allies within a 60 ft radius of yourself for 1d4 plus the caster’s spellcasting ability modifier per target.
fields.Limits: Neither spell affects Undead or Constructs.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
